description: maio (i-mobile) rewarded/interstitial video ad SDK — legacy v1 (jp.maio.sdk.android) and v2 (jp.maio.sdk.android.v2, incl. banner)

methods.name: init
methods.note: v1 global init (all-static MaioAds). Listener-driven: MaioAdsListener.onInitialized/onChangedCanShow will NOT fire once stubbed. HANG RISK if the app blocks on onInitialized. v2 (jp.maio.sdk.android.v2) has no global init — it initialises lazily on loadAd, so its entry point is the loadAd calls below.

methods.name: canShow
methods.note: v1 canShow() / canShow(String) — boolean, naturally false.

methods.name: loadAd
methods.note: v2 static factory loadAd(MaioRequest, Context, IRewardedLoadCallback) returns a Rewarded object -> return-null. Callback (IRewardedLoadCallback.loaded/failed) will NOT fire. HANG/NPE RISK if the app dereferences the returned Rewarded or waits on the callback; show is also stubbed as backstop.

methods.name: loadAd
methods.note: Kotlin companion backing Rewarded.loadAd; returns Rewarded -> return-null.

methods.name: loadAd
methods.note: v2 static factory loadAd(MaioRequest, Context, IInterstitialLoadCallback) returns an Interstitial object -> return-null. Same callback/no-fire caveat as Rewarded.

methods.name: loadAd
methods.note: Kotlin companion backing Interstitial.loadAd; returns Interstitial -> return-null.

methods.name: load
methods.note: v2 banner load() / load(boolean) / load(boolean, String) — void. Listener-driven (MaioBannerListener); no callback fires once stubbed.

protected_patterns.reason: Returns a @NonNull MaioAdsInstance the app then calls show/canShow on; returning null would NPE at the first dereference. Its ad traffic is cut by stubbing the MaioAdsInstance show/canShow methods instead. (Leaving this un-stubbed still triggers v1 init internally, but with MaioAds.init and the instance methods stubbed no ad is shown.)
Already handled as an ad_operation (return-false); listed for clarity — never force it to return true.
Returns the SDK version string; harmless, some mediation adapters read it and may NPE on null.
